commit.message:
refactor(ui): the tool Properties are a label-left property grid

Each tool setting is one row with its label on the left and its input on
the right, in the four collapsible groups Geometry, Holder, Cutting data
and Catalog (#2014). The grid lives in tool_settings_grid; the inline
help paragraphs are now hover tooltips on the row labels. The waterjet
recipe and the catalog rows use the group header instead of a nested one.

Every edit still rides the same Apply / Add commands, so one edit is one
undoable ChangeTool. The structural test pins the groups, the labels,
the label-left order and the fold, and layout_page_tool names the new
Geometry header.

Fixes #2014

Merge origin/main into issue/2014-tool-property-grid-v2

# Conflicts:
#	crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs

feat(ui): give the tool body and profile editor its own window

The tool page in Properties keeps the tool settings and the one side
preview, and one button opens the tool shape editor in its own window.
The shape window puts the holder library first, then the Body / Profile
tabs, and lays the outline controls and the side view in two columns so
no row or button is clipped. The old combined tool editor window is
removed; New tool... starts a blank numbered draft in Properties.

Fixes #2397

test(ui): scroll to Apply before the click in the inch-mode tool draft pin

The tool settings now live on the Properties page (#2397), so at the
default shell height the Apply button sits below the scroll fold and
the bare click hit nothing. Use the scroll_to_me idiom the op-page
draft test carries.

Refs #2397

Merge origin/main into issue/2014-tool-property-grid-v2

Two clashes with the plasma cut-data recipe PR (#2596) and the tool
preview wordings on main:

- tool_cutting_rows: both sides wrapped the cutting block in chrome. The
  plasma PR added a CollapsingHeader; this branch's property grid already
  opens the block in its "Cutting data" group. One collapsible stays -
  the grid's - and the plasma PR's rules stay with it: a plasma recipe
  does not fill a material slot (!r.is_recipe()), and the six-column mill
  table scrolls across so it never widens the settings column.
- tests/tool_holder_reference: keep this branch's tab-click pin and
  main's "In use: library holder ..." wording.

Refs #2014

Merge updated #2663 head into issue/2397-tool-shape-window

Keep the shape window's editor, profile_view and its side_view;
take main's #2007 one-preview wording, preview_inputs, the wrapped
tab row and the points-grid fixes. The property page calls
	ool_preview::draw with the new signature.

test(ui): fit the tool-page tests to the refreshed main

#2397 moved the Profile tab into the tool shape window, so three of
main's tests need the window's layout:

- tool_profile_structure: query the "Tool shape: ..." window; the
  controls column and the view column replace the third-column
  assertions.
- layout_page_tool_profile is a rename: its subject moved with the
  tab, and layout_window_tool_shape now carries main's door-inside
  and table-keeps-rows checks.
- waterjet_recipe: the cutting group gained main's CollapsingHeader;
  the harness opens it with the same click a user makes, since the
  seeded tool's first frame has no recipe row.

The production tree is untouched by this commit.

fix(ui): give the waterjet recipe feed a feed-rate field

The recipe block's Feed row used the length widget: it showed
`731.0 mm` under a feed-rate label in both unit modes. Add a
`num_feed_row` field (feed suffix, feed precision, unit lens) in
`fields.rs` and use it in the recipe block, named by its row
label like the other `prop_row` inputs.

Drop the nested `CollapsingHeader` the plasma recipe PR kept on
main around this block: the settings grid's Cutting data group
header is the one header, per the PR body and
`docs/decisions/2014-tool-property-grid.md`. The plasma rule that
a recipe fills no material slot stays.

Pinned by
`waterjet_recipe_feed_row_reads_as_a_feed_rate_in_both_unit_modes`.
Merge updated parent #2663 head (ae4f36fca) into issue/2397-tool-shape-window

fix(ui): select the saved tool when Add tool lands

#2397 review: after View > Tool library... > New tool... > Add tool,
the page kept the new-tool form. The saved tool was not selected, so
the Edit tool shape door was unreachable without a second click in the
tool browser. The page now targets the saved tool in the same frame,
so Edit tool shape stands right where the flow ended.

Pinned by egui_app::tests::tool_shape_window::
add_tool_selects_the_saved_tool_and_opens_its_shape.

Refs #2397

test(ui): keep the waterjet recipe pins on the grid tool page

The merge of the parent head ae4f36fca (#2663 v2) left
waterjet_recipe.rs mixed: its harness still clicked the removed
CollapsingHeader "Cutting data by material and thickness", and the
feed-row pin still queried the old "Tool: Recipe nozzle" window.
Both sides had rewritten the same region for different layouts.

The rows now stand in the settings grid's Cutting data group, which
draws open, and the recipe is edited on the Properties page (#2397).
The pins target that page and need no header click. All four pins
pass again.

Refs #2397
